name: TDspTsf
description: TinySoundFont (schellingb/TinySoundFont, MIT) as a Teensy Audio Library source. A COMPLETE runtime SF2 renderer — velocity layers, region layering, all generators, filters, envelopes, GM drums — configured for Teensy 4.1: samples resident in PSRAM (extmem allocators), font streamed off SD (no stdio). Wrapped as AudioSynthTsf, a stereo int16 AudioStream. The full-fidelity alternative to the sf22aswt/AudioSynthWavetable engine; needs a compact font that fits PSRAM.
